records.title: A human adipose tissue cell-type transcriptome atlas
records.finding: Published data describe tissue cellular transcriptomes; sample count is not a count of independent donors.
records.limitation: Independent donor count and overlap not established in this extraction. Expression estimates do not establish protein activity or individual physiological response.

records.title: Human subcutaneous and visceral adipocyte atlases uncover classical and nonclassical adipocytes and depot-specific patterns
records.location: Results, Human fat depot-specific adipocyte atlases; Figure 1; Methods, Collection of human samples
records.finding: Human tissue samples show cellular heterogeneity. Multiple nuclei from each sample do not constitute independent human participants.
records.limitation: Selected surgical cohort and sampled abdominal tissue; not a validated model of individual anatomy or longitudinal physiology.

notes: Counts transcribed from specified publication sections; not reanalysis.
Do not pool nuclei, samples or donors, or combine studies as independent cohorts.
No inferred genotype or intervention effects.
